name: shieldlabs
description: Integrate ShieldLabs identification, risk signals and Risk Score into your website or application: browser identification, server-side verdicts, signed webhooks, risk decisions, account-abuse checks and investigations with the ShieldLabs MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Identification, risk signals and Risk Score for your website or application
interface.longDescription: Detect risky users and stop abuse of your product. These skills add the ShieldLabs browser SDK to your frontend, read verdicts on your backend with the ShieldLabs server SDKs, verify signed webhooks, turn Risk Scores, bands and detection flags into decisions, use backend High-Risk Events and domain-scoped History cards, and investigate requests, users and devices with the hosted ShieldLabs MCP with OAuth, domain management and signed webhook delivery tests.
defaultPrompt: Add ShieldLabs to this app and protect signup with a server-side check
Audit the ShieldLabs integration in this project
